projects.title: Thermal Detection Surveillance Multi-Rotor Copter (Capstone Project)
projects.description:
- Thermal Detection Surveillance system based on Multi-Rotor Copter
- Developed to lower the cost of unmanned surveillance helicopters that are commercially on sale for $20K+
- Instead of an expensive commercial thermal camera, DIY thermal camera was used (Infrared sensor and Arduino micro controller based)
- Real time GPS data and Thermal image data transfer via RF transmission system
- Human or other creatures can be detected by the software implemented using MATLAB with raw thermal image date from the event location
- Final grade of A+
